title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.9
notes: See your captions in DaVinci before adding them. Click any caption in the captions column and it appears in Resolve's viewer over your footage, styled exactly as it will be on the timeline; change a color, font or position and the viewer updates. The interface got a full redesign: settings are grouped into clear sections with plain-language labels, the sidebar follows the order you work in, presets show what they do and which one is in use, and the Style preview shows your own caption instead of sample text. Scrollbars now match the rest of the app.
